_: Visual Pinball tables of the games PAD reads, by platform (PAD-943, surveyed 2026-11-02).
PAD ships no table: each entry says where its author put it. `kind`: tribute = a scripted original with its own
VBScript rules (what vpxshadow.py bridges to the real game); mashup = an older game's ROM under the playfield
(what a .vpxmap.json patcher bridges); vpm = runs the real ROM through Visual PinMAME (SAM: nothing to bridge,
the game's own code plays; PAD's edited game goes into that ROM set). `faithful`: the table is the machine's own
layout, so the real game's switches and inserts fit it; a themed tribute of the film or band is not.
`map`: the kit's map for it, when there is one. VPUniverse and VPForums downloads take a free account.
